# Renata Alberigi

> Brazilian painter & visual artist. Painting made by hand. Renata works with oil and acrylic painting, inspired by trees, rocks and river waters. A separate collection presents her hand-drawn digital paintings.

English is the default language. Brazilian Portuguese is available at pt-br/. These documents describe the same portfolio shown to people; there are no additional credentials or private artwork records for agents.

Public portfolio preview for editorial review; not the final release.

Artwork titles and credited institutions retain their original names. A listed work is not automatically available for sale or licensed for reuse. This index neither authorizes training nor guarantees inclusion in search or any selection process.

## Portfolio

- [English portfolio and biography](https://contato675.github.io/renata-alberigi-portfolio/index.md): Artist profile, biography, contact and selected works.
- [Portfólio e biografia em português](https://contato675.github.io/renata-alberigi-portfolio/pt-br/index.md): Artist profile, biography, contact and selected works.
